lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simpa using mem
  case abs | tabs => left; constructor; exact lc
  case sub ih => exact ih lc rfl
  case app l r il ir =>
    right
    cases lc with | app ll lr =>
      rcases il ll rfl with v | ⟨u, h⟩
      · rcases ir lr rfl with w | ⟨u, h⟩
        · obtain ⟨σ, b, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs v
          exact ⟨_, .abs ll w⟩
        · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ v h⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appₗ lr h⟩
  case tapp d s ih =>
    cases lc with | tapp lt ls =>
      have := ih lt rfl
      grind only [→ canonical_form_tabs, → Value.lc, → Red.tabs, → Red.tapp]
  case let' d _ ih _ =>
    have body := body_let.mp lc
    have := ih body.1 rfl
    grind only [→ Red.let_body, → Red.let_bind]
  case inl d _ ih | inr d _ ih =>
    have := ih d.wf.2.1 rfl
    grind only [→ Value.inl, → Value.inr, → Red.inl, → Red.inr]
  case case d _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    have body := (body_case.mp lc).2
    rcases ih d.wf.2.1 rfl with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum v
      · cases v with | inl v => exact ⟨_, .case_inl v body.1 body.2⟩
      · cases v with | inr v => exact ⟨_, .case_inr v body.1 body.2⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .case h body.1 body.2⟩
